problem_statement: Build a brand-new Task Assignments page at the /assignments route from scratch on the react admin site ivandi1980__ivandjoh-admin-panel. The route /assignments does not exist in baseline (renders empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system: the shared left Sidebar and top Navbar components, the brand blue (#1f5ce0), gray body text, and white card/box styling. The page shows a 'Task Assignments' title (h1) with a 'Save board' button, a subtitle, and a live 'N assigned / M total' summary (h2). Below that, a white card titled 'Task queue' (h3) lists five tasks; each row shows a priority pill, the task name, an Owner cell, and a click-driven owner picker (a row of buttons Ada / Ben / Cid, NOT a native select). Clicking an owner button assigns that owner to that row (React useState): the row's Owner cell updates and the 'N assigned' summary recomputes live. A 'Sort by priority' button reorders the rows by priority. CRITICAL STATE-LINKAGE: assignments must PERSIST across the sort — after assigning an owner to a task then clicking Sort by priority, that task must still show its owner and the assigned count must be unchanged (assignment state is keyed by task id, only the row order changes). The layout must not overflow horizontally on mobile (390px), and adding the page must not regress the existing Dashboard page's shared sidebar.
required_content: Reuse the site Sidebar and Navbar components (design-system reuse); the shared Sidebar nav links (Dashboard, Users, Products, Assignments) render on the new page
A page title h1 'Task Assignments' plus a 'Save board' button (data-cta=save-board)
A subtitle paragraph 'Assign an owner to each task and track how much of the board is covered.'
A live summary heading h2 'N assigned / M total' (data-assigned-count) that starts at '0 assigned / 5 total'
A white card titled 'Task queue' (h3) with a 'Sort by priority' button (data-sort=priority)

A list of five task rows, each with a priority pill, the task name (e.g. 'Q3 delivery schedule'), an Owner cell (p[data-owner=<taskId>] defaulting to 'Unassigned'), and an owner picker of click-driven buttons Ada / Ben / Cid (data-assign=<taskId>:<owner>, NOT a native <select>)

Clicking an owner button assigns that owner to the row (real useState interaction): the Owner cell shows the owner name and the 'N assigned' summary recomputes live (assign one -> '1 assigned / 5 total')

STATE-LINKAGE: assignments persist across a priority sort — after assigning task t3 to 'Ada' then clicking 'Sort by priority', the row still shows owner 'Ada' and the count stays '1 assigned / 5 total' (assignment state survives the reorder)
Reuse brand blue #1f5ce0 for headings/live-count/primary button and the site's gray body text + white card styling
Responsive: at 390px width the page must not overflow horizontally (rows wrap, sidebar collapses)

Render each task name in a

element (e.g.

Q3 delivery schedule

) inside its row, next to the priority pill and Owner cell
design_constraints: Reuse Sidebar + Navbar layout shell (flex: 1 / flex: 6) like the Home and Messages pages
Brand blue #1f5ce0 for headings, live count, primary button; #134bc3 hover
Gray (#888/gray) for secondary text; white cards with rgb(230,227,227) borders and the site box-shadow
Owner picker is a click-driven segmented button group (data-assign attributes), never a native <select> (the capture harness has no select_option verb)
Deterministic in-memory task data (no network fetch)

Exact palette tokens (match the site design system): brand blue #1f5ce0 = rgb(31,92,224); hover #134bc3; secondary text gray #888 = rgb(136,136,136); card border rgb(230,227,227) (site body border rgb(220,218,218)); light-blue accent rgb(236,232,255); white #ffffff cards; font-family 'Nunito, sans-serif'; card box-shadow rgba(201,201,201,0.47) 2px 4px 10px 1px; border-radius 5px on pills/buttons/cards
author_notes: 方案A T4: baseline 缺 /assignments (empty route element <></>); reference 完整实现 owner-assign + 排序; bad 保留全部结构与初次 assign,但 sortByPriority 里多写 setOwners({}) → 点 Sort 后所有 owner 被清空、count 归零 → 仅 persistence interaction_assertion (assign t3:Ada 后排序,ownerName 仍含 Ada) 在 bad 上失败;初次 assign 的 interaction_assertion (1 assigned) 与全部 dom_assertions 仍过。共享 Sidebar 的 nav 改成 <a>(react-router Link)以便 dom_assertion 断言,三份工作区 Sidebar 字节一致。跨页一致性+回归: 共享 Sidebar 的 Dashboard/Users 链接同时断言在 desktop_assignments 与 sibling desktop_home;regression gate 在 desktop_home。CRA5 react-scripts 5.0.1 + MUI5 + react-router-dom v6, no basename/auth/catch-all. Navbar avatar 拉 iriset.in 远程图 → console_error_allowlist 已含 iriset/profile.png。offline build: NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider CI=false npm run build (三份均 exit 0)。
